_description: The WebSocket event that announces a change of a provider's limit state (RL7). SHAPE ONLY: no producer exists yet — RL2 (counters) and RL4 (breaker) will raise it — but the shape is settled here, in the backend type `ProviderRateLimitEvent` and in the frontend types, so the interface and the chat contract can be built against it. `status` is ok | limited | overloaded | unknown; `reason` carries `quota` when the limit (ours or the provider's) is reached and distinguishes it from an overload (`retry after`), which is the line RL3 draws. `credential` is the credential REFERENCE, never a value.
